sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Icon and type imports
sections.what: Brings in two icons and the type for search results. Nothing on screen comes from this part directly.
sections.why: Likely reason: the panel needs these icons and the result shape to be drawn and checked.

sections.name: AiAnswer
sections.title: AI answer panel with clickable citations
sections.what: Shows the question, its interpretation, and the answer text. Bracketed numbers in the answer become buttons that open the matching signal. The header says how many signals were searched, whether the result is recorded or cached, and whether it is a placeholder built by keyword rules.
sections.why: Likely reason: each claim can be checked against its source, and placeholder answers are labelled clearly.
sections.watch_out: A bracketed number with no matching result is shown as plain text, so a broken citation looks like ordinary text.

summary: Shows the answer from the AI signal search, with each cited number linked to the signal it came from.
purpose: Lets a user read a grounded answer and open the signals behind each claim.
why: Likely reason: keeps answers traceable to captured evidence, and labels stand-in answers so they are not mistaken for model output.
how: 1. Receives a search result with the question, answer text, numbered results, and counts. 2. Maps each citation number to its signal. 3. Splits the answer text at bracketed numbers. 4. Turns each known number into a button that opens its signal. 5. Shows counts, cache status, truncation and placeholder notes.
inputs: A search result object (query, answer, interpretation, numbered results, number of signals searched, cache and truncation flags, optional recorded or placeholder markers), plus a function to open a signal and a function to clear the search.
outputs: A panel with the answer text, clickable citations, and explanatory notes about how the answer was produced.
risks: A citation number with no matching result is shown as plain text, so a broken reference is not flagged. Only the first 500 filtered signals are searched when results are truncated. The placeholder note is cut off in the packet.
debug: If a citation does nothing, check that the result numbers match the bracketed numbers in the answer. If the label says placeholder, check whether a model was available when the result was made. If the count looks low, check the truncation flag and the filters.
